contexts.text: That companions are not to be defrauded of external truths, which are the doctrinal things according to which they live, and also rituals. Signified.
Aaron = the truth of faith which proceeds mediately from the Lord, thus external truth.
Statute = the external truth of the Church.
The things which follow in this chapter are the external truths which are of worship.
Conjunction with those who are in the delights of external truth. Signified.
They who are in the delights of external truth are the outermost... and close the Church.
The external truth of the Most Ancient Church. Signified.
To shave the hair and consume the beard = to deprive of the external truths of the Church.
The truths which are only in the memory... are called relatively external truths...
